Fra to regnskap til ett kontrollgrunnlag: From two sets of books to one review package.
Regnskapsføreren godkjenner to ulike sel: The accountant approves two different companies and balance-sheet accounts dedicated to this counterparty. Both sets of books and all selected positions must be in NOK.
Hent inngående saldo, bevegelser og utgå: Retrieve opening balances, movements and closing balances. Detail lines are checked against movements, and balances are retrieved again afterwards.
Last ned HTML, CSV og JSON med saldoer,: Download HTML, CSV and JSON with balances, source IDs and unresolved lines. Manual runs and monthly runs for the last completed month are prepared.
Manglende, mislykkede eller inkonsistent: Missing, failed or inconsistent data produces an incomplete check. It is never replaced with zero.
En lik saldo beviser ikke at alle transa: Equal balances do not prove that all transactions are included. Unresolved lines are not confirmed bookkeeping errors.
Kandidatforslag krever bekreftet felles: Candidate suggestions require a confirmed shared invoice reference, equal opposite amounts and dates within the selected window. Amount alone is never enough.
Duplikater, delte oppgjør, reverseringer: Duplicates, split settlements, reversals and corrections require review. Mixed-counterparty accounts and currency conversion are outside scope.
Nye saldohentinger oppdager enkelte endr: Retrieving balances again detects some changes during the run. It does not provide an atomic historical snapshot.
Arbeidsflyten gjør bare GET-forespørsler: The workflow only makes GET requests to selected Conta endpoints. It does not post entries, make payments or send email. No AI or OCR is used.
Conta-nøkkelen arver brukerens rettighet: The Conta key inherits the user's privileges and is not inherently read-only. Store your own keys in n8n credentials, never in the workflow file.
Rapportene inneholder regnskapsdata og s: Reports contain accounting data and must remain private. Before enabling monthly runs, approve access and retention in n8n.
